desc:
🏁 Race to the top by guessing famous character colors!

🎨 Guess the main color of popular characters.
🗼 The closer your guess, the more layers you earn!
🌋 Don't let the lava catch you!
🏆 Beat your friends and reach the top first!

✨ FEATURES
🎨 30+ Famous Characters
💎 Earn Gems every game
🛒 Unlock Tower Skins & Emotes
🔥 Climb the Leaderboards
🤖 Play with friends

👍 Leave a Like if you enjoy the game!
⭐ Favorite to support future updates!

CODE "RELEASE" FOR REWARDS
